questions.stem: A train of length 200 m crosses a pole in 10 seconds. Find the speed of the train in km/h.
questions.explanation: B is correct. Speed = 200/10 = 20 m/s. Converting: 20 × 18/5 = 72 km/h.

questions.stem: A cyclist covers 180 km in 6 hours. What is his speed?
questions.explanation: C is correct. Speed = Distance/Time = 180/6 = 30 km/h.

questions.stem: A car travels for 3 hours at 60 km/h and then 2 hours at 75 km/h. What is the total distance covered?
Two trains 150 m and 200 m long run in the same direction at 72 km/h and 54 km/h respectively. How long does the faster train take to pass the slower one completely?
questions.explanation: C is correct. Relative speed = 72−54 = 18 km/h = 18×5/18 = 5 m/s. Total length = 150+200 = 350 m. Time = 350/5 = 70 seconds.

questions.stem: A man rows 30 km downstream in 2 hours and 18 km upstream in 3 hours. What is the speed of the current?
questions.explanation: C is correct. Downstream speed = 30/2 = 15 km/h. Upstream speed = 18/3 = 6 km/h. Speed of current = (downstream − upstream)/2 = (15−6)/2 = 4.5 km/h.

questions.stem: A person walking at 5 km/h reaches his destination 30 minutes earlier than when he walks at 4 km/h. Find the distance to his destination.
questions.explanation: C is correct. Let distance = d. d/4 − d/5 = 30/60 → d(5−4)/20 = 1/2 → d/20 = 1/2 → d = 10 km.

questions.stem: Two cars P and Q are 300 km apart and travel towards each other. P travels at 50 km/h and Q travels at 100 km/h. After how many hours do they meet?
questions.explanation: B is correct. Combined speed = 50+100 = 150 km/h. Time = 300/150 = 2 hours.

questions.stem: A train running at 54 km/h takes 20 seconds to pass a platform. The same train passes a man standing on the platform in 12 seconds. Find the length of the platform.
questions.explanation: C is correct. Speed = 54×5/18 = 15 m/s. Train length = 15×12 = 180 m. Train+platform = 15×20 = 300 m. Platform = 300−180 = 120 m.

questions.stem: A man covers half his journey at 20 km/h and the remaining half at 30 km/h. Find his average speed for the entire journey.
questions.explanation: A is correct. Average speed for equal distances = 2uv/(u+v) = 2×20×30/(20+30) = 1200/50 = 24 km/h. **Short Trick:** The harmonic mean of speeds when each half is equal distance.

questions.stem: A thief is spotted by a policeman from a distance of 300 m. The thief starts running and the policeman chases. The thief runs at 6 km/h and the policeman at 9 km/h. In how many minutes will the policeman catch the thief?
questions.explanation: B is correct. Relative speed = 9−6 = 3 km/h. Distance = 300 m = 0.3 km. Time = 0.3/3 = 0.1 hours = 0.1×60 = 6 minutes.
